worldcombat.skill.gearup.summary: Engages its gears and throws the drive down a short chain of teeth into Plus/Minus allies right beside it, raising Attack and Sp. Atk together; the drive spins out after a while and the boost is taken back.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.use.0: Raise both offenses of Plus/Minus partners at close range
worldcombat.skill.gearup.use.1: Wind up the damage before a close scuffle
worldcombat.skill.gearup.description.0: Throws the drive down a tooth chain of radius %1$s blocks, lasting %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.description.1: Allied Plus/Minus Pokemon in the ring gain %1$s stage of Attack and %2$s stage of Sp. Atk.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.steady.on: Steady: +1 more Attack and Sp. Atk, x1.15 wider chain, x1.25 longer run, at +3 ticks telegraph and x1.12 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.steady.off: Overdrive: cheaper telegraph and cooldown, an x0.8 shorter chain, a shorter run and the base stages.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.timing: Self move, covering a %1$s block radius; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.growth.0: From level %1$s: run lasts %2$s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.growth.1: From level %1$s: run lasts %2$s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.preference.stea: Steady: +1 more Attack and Sp. Atk, x1.15 wider chain, x1.25 longer run, at +3 ticks telegraph and x1.12 cooldown - stand and spread the drive. Overdrive: cheaper telegraph and cooldown, an x0.8 shorter chain, a shorter run and base stages - one close burst.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.preference.ai.m: Consider the gears only while a threat or the partner is this close; larger starts earlier and walks further.
worldcombat.skill.gearup.preference.ai.p: How wide the move's own ring counts; larger reaches for further Plus/Minus allies.
world_combat.move.gearup.text.spin: Gear Up (Attack +%1$s / Sp. Atk +%2$s / %3$s linked / %4$s s)
